title: Sources: Gen Digital, created by the 2022 merger of NortonLifeLock and Avast, has made a takeover offer for GoDaddy, which has a market cap of $12.2B (Oliver Barnes/Financial Times)
summary: Oliver Barnes / Financial Times: Sources: Gen Digital, created by the 2022 merger of NortonLifeLock and Avast, has made a takeover offer for GoDaddy, which has a market cap of $12.2B — Talks between web domain provider and Gen Digital at early stage but could allow acquirer to broaden its business beyond cyber security
